summary: check:stories — every named export in a *.stories.tsx must be typed `: Story`. AspectRatio exported the placeholder image its stories share, and Storybook's CSF indexer calls EVERY named export as a story, so processCSFFile crashed and the whole file failed to load in Storybook. Nothing caught it: tsc is happy, ESLint is happy, and the `stories` vitest project is happy too, because addon-vitest imports the module and reads only the exports it recognises. Only a full Storybook build sees it, and a build is far too slow to be the feedback loop for 'did I just export a constant'. Probed by re-introducing the exact export. Also fixed alongside: lint-licensing walked `storybook-static`, so a local `pnpm verify` run any time after a Storybook build reported fifteen violations in Storybook's own bundled fonts — CI never saw it only because it builds Storybook after that gate.

migration.manual: Tooling only. A shared constant in a story file must not be exported — drop the keyword. Added to `verify` and enumerated in ci.yml.
